note:
Clumber Road on the 1901 census - two households, sixteen people - read from the enumerator's page and checked by A. Hagues. The Kipping household from the same stretch is in its own file, A. Hagues having supplied that schedule in full.

**Both households are unfiled.** Schedule 180 is headed only "Clumber Road": Richard Challands, a retired lace manufacturer of 59 born at Bottesford, his wife, four grown daughters and three servants. Schedule 181 is headed **"Gardenwood"**, a name the record has never held on this street or any other, and gives Francis R. Ellis, a colliery director, his wife, two daughters and three servants.

The record keeps eleven properties on Clumber Road East and West between them, all named - Adam House, Edale House, Jelenice, Penrhyn House, Westwood, Holly Lodge, Linden House, Felixstowe, St Helier. Gardenwood is none of them.
source: 1901 census enumerator's page for Clumber Road, Nottingham, transcribed by A. Hagues.
